style.look: stylized 3D animated family film, soft global illumination, gentle depth of field, expressive faces, warm and reverent
style.negative: photorealistic, text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed face, flicker

tara.description: 8-year-old Indian girl, two braids with red ribbons, big expressive brown eyes, yellow cotton kurta

dadi.description: 70-year-old Indian grandmother, silver hair in a bun, round gold-rim glasses, cream cotton saree with maroon border, kind wrinkles, warm smile

brahma.description: Lord Brahma, four bearded faces, four arms holding Vedas, lotus, kamandalu and rosary, saffron-gold garments, seated on pink lotus, serene

vishnu.description: Lord Vishnu, blue complexion, four arms holding shankha, sudarshan chakra, gada and padma, yellow pitambara, jewelled crown, gentle smile

shiva.description: Lord Shiva, ash-blue skin, eyes closed in meditation, matted jata with crescent moon and Ganga, serpent around neck, trishul beside him

living_room.description: cozy Indian living room at dusk, wooden sofa with cushions, lit brass diya, window with orange-blue sky, framed family photos

music.prompt: soft devotional ambient, tanpura drone, bansuri flute, gentle, 70 bpm

lines.speaker: tara
lines.caption: Daadi, jab sooraj, chaand, aur Brahmaand bhi nahi tha... tab kya tha?
lines.tts: दादी, जब सूरज, चाँद, और ब्रह्मांड भी नहीं था... तब क्या था?

lines.speaker: dadi
lines.caption: Tab na koi roop tha, na koi ujaala — bas ek pavitra dhwani thi: 'Om'. Itni sookshm ki kisi ne kabhi nahi suni, phir bhi wo hamesha se goonj rahi thi.
lines.tts: तब न कोई रूप था, न कोई उजाला — बस एक पवित्र ध्वनि थी: ओम्। इतनी सूक्ष्म कि किसी ने कभी नहीं सुनी, फिर भी वो हमेशा से गूँज रही थी।

shots.keyframe_prompt: wide shot, Dadi and Tara sitting together on the sofa, Tara holding a plain black sheet of paper, diya glowing, dusk window light
shots.motion_prompt: subtle breathing, diya flame flickers, Tara looks at the paper then up at Dadi, static camera

shots.keyframe_prompt: medium close-up of Tara on the sofa, puzzled wide eyes, holding black paper at chest height, soft background bokeh
shots.motion_prompt: Tara asks a curious question, slight head tilt, eyebrows raised

shots.keyframe_prompt: medium close-up of Dadi, calm gentle expression, looking softly at Tara (off-screen right), warm diya light on her face
shots.motion_prompt: Dadi speaks slowly like telling a story, gentle hand gesture, soft blinks

shots.keyframe_prompt: over-the-shoulder close shot of the black sheet of paper in Tara's small hands, paper fills most of the frame
shots.motion_prompt: slow smooth camera push-in into the black paper until it fills the entire frame and everything goes dark

lines.speaker: dadi
lines.caption: Phir us khamoshi mein, Om ki shakti jaagi — jaise vigyaan aaj 'Big Bang' kehta hai — aur uski goonj se roshni phail gayi!
lines.tts: फिर उस ख़ामोशी में, ओम् की शक्ति जागी — जैसे विज्ञान आज 'बिग बैंग' कहता है — और उसकी गूँज से रोशनी फैल गई!

shots.motion_prompt: the glowing golden Om symbol contracts into a brilliant point of light and bursts outward, golden light tearing through the darkness, radiant particles, cinematic
concentric waves of golden light and energy expand and fill the entire dark void, nebula-like glow, majestic slow motion

lines.speaker: dadi
lines.caption: Om ke teen swar hote hain — A, U, aur M. Aur unhi teen swaron se Tridev prakat hue: 'A' se Brahma ji, jinhone srishti rachi; 'U' se Vishnu ji, jo sabka palan karte hain; aur 'M' se Shiv ji, jo purani cheezon ko khatam karke naye ke liye jagah banate hain.
lines.tts: ओम् के तीन स्वर होते हैं — अ, उ, और म। और उन्हीं तीन स्वरों से त्रिदेव प्रकट हुए: अ से ब्रह्मा जी, जिन्होंने सृष्टि रची; उ से विष्णु जी, जो सबका पालन करते हैं; और म से शिव जी, जो पुरानी चीज़ों को ख़त्म करके नए के लिए जगह बनाते हैं।

lines.speaker: dadi
lines.caption: Fir Brahma ji ne apni shakti se, ek-ek karke paanch tattva banaye — Aakash, phir Hawa, phir Aag, phir Paani, aur ant mein Dharti! Aur inhi paanch tattvon se hamari ye sundar duniya bani.
lines.tts: फिर ब्रह्मा जी ने अपनी शक्ति से, एक-एक करके पाँच तत्व बनाए — आकाश, फिर हवा, फिर आग, फिर पानी, और अंत में धरती! और इन्हीं पाँच तत्वों से हमारी ये सुंदर दुनिया बनी।

shots.keyframe_prompt: Brahma in golden cosmic light, one hand raised forward with open palm facing up, gentle expression
shots.motion_prompt: Brahma slowly extends his open palm forward, a soft glow gathers in the palm

shots.note: same composition for all: Brahma's open palm in lower third, element rising above it

keyframes.aakash: a swirling sphere of deep blue-violet space with tiny stars rising from the open palm
keyframes.vayu: swirling translucent streams of wind and air spiralling up from the palm
keyframes.agni: a living flame of warm orange fire dancing above the palm
keyframes.jal: a flowing sphere of clear blue water rippling above the palm
keyframes.prithvi: a small green-blue Earth slowly spinning above the palm

shots.motion_prompt: space swirls out from the glowing palm
the swirling space thickens into rushing streams of wind
the wind ignites into dancing fire
the fire cools and melts into flowing water
the water settles and solidifies into a small spinning Earth

lines.speaker: tara
lines.caption: Daadi, matlab jab main school mein 'Om' bolti hoon... wahi awaaz mere andar bhi hai?
lines.tts: दादी, मतलब जब मैं स्कूल में ओम् बोलती हूँ... वही आवाज़ मेरे अंदर भी है?
lines.note: script has 'meri andar'; corrected to 'mere andar' — confirm with writer

lines.speaker: dadi
lines.caption: Bilkul, beta. Wahi pavitra dhwani har jeev ke andar, har dhadkan mein baji hui hai!
lines.tts: बिल्कुल, बेटा। वही पवित्र ध्वनि हर जीव के अंदर, हर धड़कन में बजी हुई है!
